items: Which banks can we connect?
Bank connections run through our partner ChamsAccess. Where a bank can't connect, upload your statement and matching works the same way.
What about cash spending?
Every cash withdrawal becomes a cash advance to a named person, who retires it with receipts in SpendMerate.
What happens when a bank line does not match?
It goes to the exceptions queue, where someone explains it or links it to the right record.
